# The Barren Fig Tree (Luke 13:8)

## Emotional Focus
God gives us time to grow fruit.

## Key KJV
“Let it alone this year also, till I shall dig about it, and dung it.” (Luke 13:8)

## Gentle Retelling
A man had a fig tree that never grew figs. The gardener asked for one more year to care for it. God gives us time to grow too.

## Coloring Prompt
A gardener digging around a fig tree with hope.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“God gives us time to grow good fruit.”
